title: Nordson Corporation Reports Record Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Results
summary: Fourth Quarter: Sales were $752 million, growth of 1% over prior year Earnings per diluted share were $2.69 Adjusted earnings per diluted share were $3.03, growth of 9% over prior year Full Year: Record sales of $2.8 billion, growth of 4% over prior year’s record sales Earnings per diluted share were $8.51 Adjusted earnings per diluted share were $10.24, growth of 5% over prior year Fiscal 2026 Guidance: Fiscal 2026 forecasted sales range between $2,830 to $2,950 million and adjusted earnings in the range of $10.80 to $11.50 Nordson Corporation (Nasdaq: NDSN) today reported results for the fiscal fourth quarter ended October 31, 2025. Sales were $752 million, a 1% increase compared to the prior year’s fourth quarter sales of $744 million. The increase in fourth quarter 2025 sales included favorable currency translation of 2% and a 1% acquisition impact, which was partially offset by the medical contract manufacturing divestiture and an organic sales decrease of 1%.
